name: transforming growth factor beta receptor 3
pathways: negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction

function.text: TGFBR3 encodes transforming growth factor beta receptor type 3. Annotated molecular activities include coreceptor activity and transmembrane signaling receptor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction.
